comparisons.evidence: Ta. karmam, karumam action, work, deed, fruit of deeds, religious rites. Ma. karmam action, religious act, fate, actions of this and former lives (chiefly bad actions and their consequences). Ko. karm (obl. karm-, kart-) sin; karmn sinful man. Ka. karma, kamma action, business, religious action or rite, sin. Tu. karma action, religious ceremony, fate, sin. Te. karmamu action, religious rite, fate, fruit of actions. Skt. karman- act, action, business, work, religious rite, fate. Pkt. kamma- id. b Ta. kammavar a Telugu agricultural caste. Ka. kamme of the eight brahmanical castes (in Mysore only smārta brāhmaṇas). Te. kamma a certain caste (of Śūdras); kammari woman of the Kamma caste; kamatakādu, kam(m)atīdu, kammatagădu a laborer or slave employed in tillage; kam(m)atamu cultivation, tillage.
